input_pattern: nine registered SRC-03 C3 cases repeated cyclically

launch.timing: same-stream device event; persistent inputs and outputs

variants.name: fixed_iteration_replay
variants.purpose: replace dynamic convergence predicates with the registered per-row actual iteration count while retaining original math
variants.correctness: original C3 output, iteration and convergence contract

variants.name: lookup_asinh
variants.purpose: replace the asinh-equivalent log result along the frozen Newton trajectory; retain runtime sqrt for the derivative

variants.name: lookup_sqrt
variants.purpose: replace sqrt along the frozen Newton trajectory while retaining runtime asinh-equivalent log

variants.name: lookup_coefficient
variants.purpose: replace the invariant log plus exp coefficient path with an identical lookup

variants.name: lookup_all_transcendentals
variants.purpose: replace coefficient, sqrt and asinh-equivalent results with identical trajectory lookups

variants.name: arithmetic_placeholder
variants.purpose: preserve loop/dataflow shape but replace transcendental functions with bounded ordinary arithmetic on both backends
variants.correctness: shared variant-specific scalar FP64 reference; not compared with physical C3 output

variants.name: original_restore
variants.purpose: restore the unaltered C3 after all interventions

causal_criteria.reversibility: original_restore/original_pre latency ratio must lie in [0.9, 1.1] on each backend
causal_criteria.iteration_control: fixed replay must reproduce original registered outputs and iteration diagnostics
causal_criteria.mechanism: a function-path claim requires the cross-backend gap to shrink when removed and return after restoration
causal_criteria.profiling: latency and profiler jobs remain separate; report VGPR/VALU/VMEM only from the dedicated profiler job
causal_criteria.negative_result: if the gap does not respond reversibly, retain only an association statement

reporting: actual iteration histogram and active-lane fraction
